approval.scope: The owner approves the ten anchors of hair-draft-anchors-v2.json as PLACEMENT TARGETS with their documented uncertainty (3 px) and roles (fit: A1, A5, A7, A8; check: the other six). The approval covers the target placement only — NOT the sketch's finished hair form, and NOT any future source anchor on a generated sheet (those are unknown until a sheet exists and are annotated and approved per sheet).
approval.statusNote: Only the owner may set APPROVED. Any coordinate change is a new targets version with a new pin and a new owner decision; nothing here was moved, rounded or re-read.
